title: BusinessAlert - Data API
description: Represents information about insight notifications that Einstein Relationship Insights explores, such as news mentions, job updates, and relationships. This object is available in API version 57.0 and later.

AlertRecordId.description: The record that's referenced by the insight alert. This field is a polymorphic relationship field.
AlertRecordId.refers_to: Account, Asset, AuthorizationForm, AuthorizationFormConsent, AuthorizationFormDataUse, AuthorizationFormText, BusinessBrand, CommSubscription, CommSubscriptionChannelType, CommSubscriptionConsent, Contact, ContactPointAddress, ContactPointConsent, ContactPointEmail, ContactPointPhone, ContactPointTypeConsent, ContentVersion, Customer, DataUseLegalBasis, DataUsePurpose, EmailMessage, EngagementChannelType, Idea, Image, Individual, Lead, Location, Opportunity, PartyConsent, Pricebook2, Product2, ProfileSkill, QuickText, Recommendation, Scorecard, ScorecardMetric, Seller, SocialPersona, SocialPost, Solution, VideoCall, WorkBadgeDefinition

AlertType.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Restricted picklist, Sort, Update
AlertType.description: Specifies the type of insight alert. Possible values are: JOB_CHANGE NEWS RELATIONSHIP The default value is NEWS.

CurrentDesignation.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
CurrentDesignation.description: The current designation that's related to the job alert.

CurrentEmployer.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
CurrentEmployer.description: The name of the current employer that's related to the job alert.

LastReferencedDate.description: The timestamp when the current user last viewed a record related to this alert record.

LastViewedDate.description: The timestamp when the current user last viewed this alert.

Name.properties: Autonumber, Defaulted on create, Filter, idLookup, Sort
Name.description: The name of the alert record.

OwnerId.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Sort, Update
OwnerId.description: The ID of the user who owns the record. This field is a polymorphic relationship field.

PreviousDesignation.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
PreviousDesignation.description: The previous designation that's related to the job alert.

PreviousEmployer.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
PreviousEmployer.description: The name of the previous employer that's related to the job alert.

special_access_rules: The BusinessAlert object is available only if the ERI Growth User or ERI Starter User license is enabled.
